origin: Hot Car Competições began life in the dusty backroads of Minas Gerais, Brazil, fueled by the audacious dreams of three childhood friends: Ricardo, Marcos, and Gabriela. Tired of watching the national motorsport scene from afar, they pooled their meager savings – Ricardo's earnings from his mechanic shop, Marcos' from his family's tire business, and Gabriela's from her part-time accounting gigs – to buy a battered, retired Volkswagen Gol. Their initial goal was simple: to enter the local amateur rallycross series and prove that passion could triumph over deep pockets. The team's early days were a chaotic blend of late-night repairs, improvised solutions, and sheer determination. Their first race saw them finish dead last, but the experience ignited a fire that burned brighter than ever.
philosophy: Hot Car Competições lives by the motto 'Ginga on Wheels,' embracing the Brazilian spirit of improvisation and resilience. Their approach to car development is less about cutting-edge technology and more about maximizing the potential of readily available parts. They prioritize reliability and driver skill, believing that a well-driven, dependable car can often outpace a more sophisticated but temperamental machine. The team fosters a family-like atmosphere, where everyone's opinion is valued and camaraderie is as important as lap times.
achievements: 2nd Place Overall in the 2018 Minas Gerais Rallycross Championship
Consistent Top 10 Finishes in the Brazilian Regional Stock Car Series (Amateur Division)
Won the 'Spirit of the Race' Award at the 2021 Rio Grande do Sul Endurance Challenge
Developed and mentored several young Brazilian drivers who went on to compete at a higher level

teamPrincipal.name: Ricardo Silva
teamPrincipal.background: Ricardo is a self-taught mechanic with an encyclopedic knowledge of Brazilian automotive history. He leads by example, always the first to get his hands dirty and the last to leave the garage. He is known for his calm demeanor and his ability to inspire his team even in the face of adversity.

keyFigures.name: Marcos Oliveira
keyFigures.description: Marcos' family tire business provided Hot Car with crucial early support. He's a master of tire management and race strategy, squeezing every last bit of performance out of their limited budget.

keyFigures.name: Gabriela Santos
keyFigures.description: Gabriela keeps the team financially afloat with her meticulous budgeting and fundraising efforts. She's also the team's primary negotiator and logistical coordinator, ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes.

headquarters: Hot Car Competições is based out of a modest workshop in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais. Their facilities are basic, consisting of a few bays, a small office, and a storage area filled with spare parts salvaged from junkyards. The team compensates for their lack of resources with ingenuity and resourcefulness.
fanBase: Hot Car's fanbase is largely comprised of local motorsport enthusiasts who appreciate their underdog spirit and their commitment to showcasing Brazilian talent. They are known for their passionate support at races, often bringing homemade banners and cheering the team on with infectious enthusiasm.
